name: Mosyk
description: The Mosyk were a sentient reptilian species. They had green skin, a bone-like structure on the back of their heads—similar to Vurk—as well as as three fingers on each hand. The Jedi Master Eeko-Dio Daki, who survived Order 66 and went into hiding with his Padawan Devon Izara on the planet Janix, was a member of the species.
